transforms.name: vite:load-fallback
transforms.result:
{#if $profileStore.isLoading}
{:else if $profileStore.data}

{$t('profile.about')}

{#if $profileStore.data.about}

{$profileStore.data.about}

{:else}

{$t('profile.noDescription')}

{/if}

{$t('profile.skills.title')}

{#if $profileStore.data.skills && $profileStore.data.skills.length > 0}
{#each $profileStore.data.skills as skill}
{skill.name} {skill.verificationStatus}
{#each Array(5) as _, i} {/each}
{/each}
{:else}

{$t('profile.noSkills')}

{/if}

{$t('profile.certifications')}

{#if $profileStore.data.certifications && $profileStore.data.certifications.length > 0}
{#each $profileStore.data.certifications as cert}

{cert.name}

{#if cert.verified}
{$t('profile.verified')}
{:else}
{$t('profile.unverified')}
{/if}

{cert.issuer}

{$t('profile.since')} {formatDate(cert.date)} ({yearsFrom(cert.date)} {$t('profile.years')})

{/each}
{:else}
{$t('profile.noCertifications')}
{/if}

{$t('profile.portfolio.title')}

{#if $profileStore.data.portfolio && $profileStore.data.portfolio.length > 0}
{#each $profileStore.data.portfolio as item}

{item.title} {formatDate(item.completionDate)}

{item.description}

{#if item.images && item.images.length > 0}
{#each item.images as image, i}
{/each}
{/if}
{/each}
{:else}
{$t('profile.noPortfolio')}
{/if}

{$t('profile.reviews')}

{#if $profileStore.data.reviews && $profileStore.data.reviews.length > 0}
{#each $profileStore.data.reviews as review}
{#if review.from?.name} {review.from.name.charAt(0)} {:else} ? {/if}

{review.from?.name ?? 'Anonymous'}

{formatDate(review.date)}

{#each Array(5) as _, i} {/each}

{review.text}

{/each}
{:else}

{$t('profile.noReviews')}

{/if}
{:else if $profileStore.error}
{$t('profile.loadError')}
{/if}
